description: Filter curated Notting Hill places by category, sub-zone, tags, featured picks or text, ranked the same way as the published best-of lists. Every field carries its source; addresses, coordinates, hours and websites are not included, so call get_place for them. It cannot filter by opening hours: for what is open now, search here, then read openNow from get_place for each candidate. bestOfUrl is included only for coffee, restaurant, pub, bakery, park, shop.

category.description: Place category, for example coffee or restaurant

featured.description: When true, only return featured picks

query.description: Text matched against names and the guide's descriptions and tips

tags.description: Use-case tags; a place must carry every tag given

name: search_places
title: Search Notting Hill places
